key_patterns: Front end: every page loads core.js, data.js, store.js, [ben.js], portal.js, page script(s) synchronously; helpers $, $$, esc, icon, money, toast, openModal, openDrawer, fldOf, radio, val in core.js; per-page setup via runPage({pageKey(){...}}) in portal.js; ADMIN_PAGES table in portal.js defines which admin pages are Business-Admin-only (flag true: insights, revenue, grading, reports, policies, staff, imports); data-ba attribute elements are removed for front desk by stripBA() in admin-shell.js; DB shape and legacy aliases (MY_PASSES, STUDENTS, APPS, MEMBERS, SESSIONS, GRAD_APPS, PROPOSALS, CANDIDATES, PAYS, GRADE, FEEDBACK, BOOKINGS, ATTENDANCE, GRADE_FB, MC_REQS) come from SEED() in data.js and are array/object references, so fill them IN PLACE. Dates in the prototype are JS Dates, the API sends ISO strings that the data modules convert with ASK.d()/ASK.ts(). Backend design (see plan.md sections 1-3): routes -> controllers -> services -> models, zod validators, AppError + asyncHandler, withTx, pg type parsers (DATE as string, NUMERIC as float), clock.js for today/now with APP_FAKE_TODAY.
